v1.0.0-beta.1 SHIPPED 2026-05-07 (tag 0238934, GitHub release + Homebrew tap auto-updated). The lightweight v1.0.0 tag (e3e3a61) is on the same line of history but is a placeholder, not the public stable release.

PATH TO v1.0.0 STABLE — gated on Bun commit-phase:
- v1.0.0-beta.2: binary build swap (esbuild+postject SEA → `bun build --compile`). Half-day per project.bunMigrationScope. Pre-flight: one-line src/storage.ts fix (`export type { Scope }`). Validation gap: `bun build --compile` output not yet confirmed byte-equivalent to current SEA build — one debug-tag rerun (v0.0.0-debug.0 pattern from #96) needed before committing.
- Short-flag audit (per context.shortFlagAudit) — could ride v1.0.0-beta.2 or its own beta.
- Then v1.0.0 stable.

DEFERRED to Reverie v1.1+:
- Test-runner swap (vitest → bun:test) — 2-4 days dominated by vi.mock auto-hoist restructuring across 31 files; per project.bunMigrationScope.
- Web app / visualization layer (mindmap, topology) — pairs with #83.
- Search improvements (#13 fzf, #43 boolean operators) — user-flagged in project.v115Hints.
- Entry health / staleness work (#84).
- Cross-machine telemetry aggregation.

Test count at v1.14: 1394 (1232 pass under bun --bun run vitest; 160 skipped on a vitest-under-Bun module-transform issue documented in project.bunValidate).

DOGFOODING PART THREE: still expected, naturally pairs with v1.0.0 stable launch as the rebrand-narrative blog post.
